Thus each $G_k$ is complete multipartite with partition $\mathcal{P}_k$. Since $G_1 \subseteq \cdots \subseteq G_m = K_n$, we get a refinement chain:
$$\mathcal{P}_0 = \{V\} \succ \mathcal{P}_1 \succ \cdots \succ \mathcal{P}_m = \{\text{singletons}\}.$$

The label $w(uv) = \min\{k : u, v \text{ separated in } \mathcal{P}_k\}$.
